verdict.rationale: Cognee documents the full loop the story describes. `remember()` ingests data, including writing conversation content into a `(user_id, session_id)` session cache. `improve()` is explicitly meant to bridge short-term session memory into permanent graph memory at the end of a chat. `recall()` retrieves from that memory, auto-selecting the retrieval strategy, over combined graph and vector stores. Missing for 10: docs never explicitly name semantic or vector similarity search as a recall mode (it is only implied by the vector data and the founders' description), and there is no independent hands-on corroboration of recall quality beyond founder-reported benchmarks.
